description: Bicep storage account allowing plain HTTP and TLS 1.0
note: CIS Azure 4.1 and 4.15, the Bicep mirror of arm-storage-insecure-transfer. Bicep now has two sources, not one. KICS parses .bicep natively where Trivy has no Bicep scanner at all, so this case's self-check compares two tools and the single-source caveat multi-iac-spec §4 carried for Bicep is retired.
